name: NSGA-II seed 77 on 68-d Bed B + 14-d morphology, 2 directions, seed-77 replicate of t0106
short_description: All 2,016 per-cell NSGA-II evaluations from t0112 single random-init GA seed 77 on the 68-d Bed B electrophys + 14-d morphology DSGC substrate. Minimum-change replicate of t0106 (seed 44 -> 77, pool-restart-every 25 -> 10). HV-plateau stopped at gen 21 of a 60-gen ceiling.
model_description: Compartmental DSGC neuron model combining the 54-d Bed B electrophysiology parameter vector (from t0080) applied via apply_parameter_vector with the t0092-patched 14-d procedural morphology generator (canonical via correction C-0093-01). Each cell is evaluated with 2 stimulus directions (PD = 0 deg, ND = 180 deg) x 3 noise replicates and scored on a 2-objective vector (ratio DSI, preferred-direction firing rate in Hz). NSGA-II minimises the negated pair; the DSI silence guard from S-0102-01 clamps DSI to 0.0 when total PD+ND spike count falls below 10 spikes per trial.
prediction_schema: Top-level JSON object with key 'evaluations' holding a list of 2016 per-cell evaluation records. Each record has fields: generation (int, NSGA-II generation; 1 = initial LHS population, 2-21 = offspring generations), vector_68d (list of 68 floats, 54-d electrophys + 14-d morphology parameter vector), objective_F_minimised (list of 2 floats, the NSGA-II objective vector with sign-flipped maximisation conventions: [-ratio_dsi, -pd_rate_hz]), dsi_vector_sum (float in [0, 1], the ratio DSI (PD - ND) / (PD + ND), guard-cleaned per S-0102-01 so values of 0.0 may either be real or guard-floor; field name preserved for compatibility with t0102/t0104/t0106 schema), pd_rate_hz (float, preferred-direction mean firing rate in Hz across the 3 noise replicates).

files.description: Full per-cell NSGA-II evaluation log for t0112 GA seed 77 (2,016 cells across 21 completed generations before HV-plateau stop). gzip-compressed JSON to satisfy the 5 MB pre-commit limit; decompress with `gunzip` or `gzip -d` before json.load.
